physicalNotes: Radius: Rp/R* 0.122657, the NRS1 (2.7 to 3.7 um) value of Evans-Soma et al. (2025), Nature Astronomy, 'SiO and a super-stellar C/O ratio in the atmosphere of the giant exoplanet WASP-121b' (arXiv:2506.01771), Supplementary Table 1 (white phase-curve fit, best-fit column), times the host record's radius; NRS2 (3.8 to 5.2 um) gives 0.123736, the planet looking larger where its atmosphere is more opaque. A sphere: tidal and rotational flattening are not modelled (Mikal-Evans et al. 2023 found an oblate shape did not change their phase-curve results). GM from that fit's planet mass, 1.170 Jupiter masses, at the IAU 2015 nominal Jupiter-to-Sun mass ratio 1/1047.348644, times the JPL solar GM.
